rules.name: Chemical exposure emergency
rules.rationale: Chemical exposure can rapidly injure the eye and immediate irrigation should begin before emergency assessment.
rules.explanation_template: Chemical exposure was reported, so the highest safety pathway was selected.

rules.name: Embedded-object emergency
rules.rationale: An object that appears embedded or penetrating requires emergency assessment without manipulation.
rules.explanation_template: A possibly embedded object was reported, so emergency protection and assessment guidance was selected.

rules.name: High-speed impact emergency
rules.rationale: High-speed fragments can penetrate the eye even when the external injury appears small.
rules.explanation_template: A high-speed impact was reported, so emergency assessment was selected.

rules.name: Sudden vision-loss emergency
rules.rationale: Sudden major vision loss is an emergency symptom with several potentially sight-threatening causes.
rules.explanation_template: Sudden major vision loss was reported, so emergency eye care was selected.

rules.name: Curtain-shadow retinal emergency
rules.rationale: A curtain-like shadow is a retinal detachment warning sign that needs immediate evaluation.
rules.explanation_template: A curtain-like visual shadow was reported, so the retinal emergency pathway was selected.

rules.name: Sudden floaters with flashes
rules.rationale: The combination of sudden new floaters and flashes can accompany a retinal tear or detachment.
rules.explanation_template: Sudden new floaters and flashes were both reported, so emergency retinal assessment was selected.

rules.name: Acute angle-closure warning pattern
rules.rationale: A sudden painful red eye with nausea, halos, or vision change can signal acute angle closure.
rules.explanation_template: Severe pain and redness occurred with another acute angle-closure warning sign, so emergency care was selected.

rules.name: Injury with vision change
rules.rationale: Vision change following eye trauma can indicate a serious injury requiring emergency examination.
rules.explanation_template: Eye trauma and a new vision change were both reported, so emergency care was selected.

rules.name: Contact-lens corneal warning pattern
rules.rationale: A painful, light-sensitive, discharging, or visually affected red eye in a contact-lens wearer needs same-day corneal assessment.
rules.explanation_template: Contact-lens use, redness, and a corneal warning symptom were reported, so same-day care was selected.

rules.name: New central distortion in older adult
rules.rationale: New central distortion in an older adult can reflect a macular problem requiring rapid assessment.
rules.explanation_template: Age and new central distortion matched the urgent macular assessment pathway.

rules.name: Redness with discharge
rules.rationale: Redness with discharge can occur with infectious conjunctivitis, while assessment is needed to distinguish causes.
rules.explanation_template: Redness and discharge were reported without contact-lens use, matching a conjunctivitis pattern.

rules.name: Bilateral itchy watery eyes
rules.rationale: Prominent itching and watering in both eyes is consistent with an allergic conjunctival pattern.
rules.explanation_template: Itching, watering, and involvement of both eyes matched an allergy-associated pattern.

rules.name: Dry-eye surface pattern
rules.rationale: Burning or grittiness with watering or screen association can occur in a dry-eye pattern.
rules.explanation_template: Eye-surface discomfort and a related trigger or watering matched a possible dry-eye pattern.

rules.name: Eyelid-margin crusting pattern
rules.rationale: Crusting around the eyelashes with irritation can occur with blepharitis.
rules.explanation_template: Eyelash crusting and irritation matched a possible eyelid-margin inflammation pattern.

rules.name: Painful eyelid lump pattern
rules.rationale: A localized painful eyelid lump can arise from an inflamed eyelid gland and merits assessment if persistent or worsening.
rules.explanation_template: A painful localized eyelid lump matched the eyelid-lump pathway.

rules.name: Painless eyelid lump pattern
rules.rationale: A localized painless eyelid lump can arise from a blocked eyelid gland.
rules.explanation_template: A painless localized eyelid lump matched the eyelid-lump pathway.

rules.name: Gradual cloudy vision with glare
rules.rationale: Gradual cloudy vision and glare can occur when the eye's natural lens becomes cloudy.
rules.explanation_template: Gradual cloudy vision and glare matched a possible cataract pattern.

rules.name: Diabetes retinal-risk pathway
rules.rationale: Diabetes can affect the retina before symptoms are noticed, making regular dilated examination important.
rules.explanation_template: Diabetes was reported, so the retinal screening pathway was selected.

rules.name: Chronic glaucoma-risk pathway
rules.rationale: Family history, older age, and peripheral-vision concerns can justify comprehensive glaucoma assessment.
rules.explanation_template: One or more chronic glaucoma-risk indicators were reported, so prompt comprehensive assessment was selected.

rules.name: Gradual near blur after age forty
rules.rationale: Gradual near-vision difficulty in adulthood can occur with age-related loss of focusing ability.
rules.explanation_template: Age, gradual onset, and near blur matched a possible presbyopia pattern.

rules.name: Non-sudden distance or near blur
rules.rationale: Non-sudden distance or near blur without severe pain can be associated with a refractive error.
rules.explanation_template: A non-sudden blur pattern without severe pain matched the routine refraction pathway.
